findings.evidence: Advisory only, not blocking. Agenda queries use staleTime 120s. If the tab stays open across local midnight in the calendar zone and the agenda is not refetched, a strip anchored only to fetched_at would still mark the previous day as 'today' and could keep showing already-passed starts as upcoming. I did not verify the refetch-on-focus behavior or the global QueryClient defaults.
findings.fix: Optional: when the current date in the chosen zone differs from the fetched_at date, qualify the strip as 'as of <fetched_at>' or disable 'today' emphasis until the next fetch. Add a test with a fake clock past midnight. Do not add a new backend call.
